title: Celestial Programmer Witch
description: A mystical witch with long flowing purple hair adorned with stars sits barefoot at a wooden desk in a cluttered room, typing on a laptop displaying green code while reaching toward a glowing orb on the floor that emits ethereal white energy. The scene is filled with scattered clothes, papers, coffee mugs, a fan, and cherry blossom branches, under a dramatic night sky ceiling with constellations, galaxies, and pinned artwork on the walls.
prompt: A beautiful witch with long flowing purple hair filled with stars and galaxies, wearing a dark flowing dress, sits barefoot at a wooden desk in a messy bedroom studio, typing on a laptop with green code on screen, her other hand reaching toward a glowing magical orb on the floor emitting swirling white ethereal energy and sparkles, room is cluttered with scattered black and colored clothes, papers, coffee cups, a small fan, cherry blossom branches growing around the desk with pink flowers, walls covered with pinned drawings and notes, dramatic cosmic night sky ceiling with stars constellations and colorful nebulae, highly detailed fantasy digital painting
